*Reconstructing the Concept of Exclusion in Private Monopolization* was released by Shojihomu on April 8.

I had hoped to make a short explanatory video for a general audience, but I have been too busy to finish it.

This is a theme I have worked on since around 2016, and it forms the foundation of the research I am doing now. As the fruit of my first research project it surely has shortcomings, but I would be glad if you took a look.
